description: This file defines functions for lazy loading and caching of runtime modules, surfaces, named exports, and methods in a TypeScript/JavaScript project. It provides utility functions to asynchronously load modules and surfaces, cache them, and create lazy-loaded method invocations.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeSurface<TModule, TSurface>( createLazyRuntimeSurface
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded and cached surface from an imported module, using a selector function to derive the surface.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeModule<TModule>( createLazyRuntimeModule
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded module that caches the raw imported module.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeNamedExport<TModule, const TKey extends keyof TModule>( createLazyRuntimeNamedExport
methods.description: Creates a lazily loaded named export from a module, avoiding repeated selector functions.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethod<TSurface, TArgs extends unknown[], TResult>( createLazyRuntimeMethod
methods.description: Creates a method that lazily loads a surface and invokes a selected method with provided arguments.

methods.name: export function createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder<TSurface>(load: () => Promise<TSurface>) { createLazyRuntimeMethodBinder
methods.description: Returns a function that can create lazy methods bound to a loaded surface.
